name: Hydrated Dollar
oneLiner: HOLLAR is Hydration's overcollateralized dollar stablecoin, minted from DOT, ETH, BTC, and stablecoin collateral on an Aave v3 fork with HSM-anchored peg swaps.
collateral: Overcollateralized by DOT, ETH, vDOT, WBTC, tBTC, USDT, USDC, and giga-token variants (GIGADOT, GIGAETH) on the Hydration appchain; built on Aave v3-forked code
pegMechanism: Overcollateralized CDP with automated partial liquidations per block; peg stabilized by the HOLLAR Stability Module (HSM), which enables direct stablecoin swaps near $1 and deploys received stablecoins into yield strategies

mintAuthority.summary: HOLLAR is minted on the Hydration appchain by depositing DOT/ETH/BTC/stablecoin collateral into an Aave v3 (GHO-derived) money market, with the HOLLAR Stability Module anchoring the peg; Hydration governance controls collateral and risk parameters.

controls.label: Hydration Aave-v3 fork money market (minter)
controls.capDescription: HOLLAR mints only against overcollateralized positions on Hydration's Aave-v3-forked (GHO-style) money market, subject to a per-asset supply cap; the launch supply cap was 2,000,000 HOLLAR.
controls.evidence: Coverage describes HOLLAR as a GHO-derived facilitator mint on Hydration's Aave v3 fork with overcollateralized positions and an initial supply cap of 2,000,000 HOLLAR.

controls.label: Hydration governance / parameter admin
controls.capDescription: Hydration governance sets collateral onboarding, risk parameters, supply caps, and the HSM configuration; HOLLAR is governed by Hydration rather than Polkadot OpenGov directly.
controls.evidence: Coverage notes HOLLAR is governed by Hydration (not DOT holders), which controls collateral rules, risk parameters, and the on-chain HOLLAR Stability Module.

review.evidence: Hydration press and coverage describe HOLLAR as an Aave-v3/GHO-derived overcollateralized stablecoin with the native HSM for peg support, governed by Hydration with parameter-level control over collateral and caps.
review.sourceFreeRationale: Aave-v3/GHO fork mint model and Hydration governance confirmed from coverage and docs; the appchain pallet/governance admin authority was not independently read on-chain.
unresolvedQuestions: Resolve the Hydration on-chain governance/admin authority over the HOLLAR money market and HSM parameters before raising confidence.
